build_voyage_rerank_config: build a VoyageRerankConfig instance to handle rerank API calls for Voyage AI models
map_cohere_rerank_params: map cohere-style rerank parameters to Voyage AI API parameters with top_k instead of top_n
get_complete_url: get the complete Voyage AI rerank API URL from a base URL or default endpoint
transform_rerank_request: transform rerank request by prepending model field to optional parameters for Voyage AI
transform_rerank_response: transform Voyage AI rerank response into LiteLLM RerankResponse format
validate_environment: validate environment by retrieving API key and returning authorization headers
calculate_rerank_cost: calculate rerank cost from billed units and model cost per token
get_error_class: get the VoyageError class with error message, status code, and headers
